item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las sbyin sreg cho ga
item.coloph: 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum gyi lung don/ dbal gshen stag la me 'bar gyi brnag pa/ lha klu mi gsum gyi snyan rgyud/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyi thugs dam gsang ba'o/ phyi rabs don du bla chen po dran pa nam mkhas/ stang dmu tsha gyer med la gdams te/ byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la bka' gter du spros so/ u ya/ bkra shis 'gro ba'i don rnams lhun 'grub shog/ 'chi med yum sras gshen gsum gyi lung don/ dbal gshen stag la me 'bar gyi brnag pa/ lha klu mi gsum gyi snyan rgyud/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyi thugs dam gsang ba'o/ phyi rabs don du bla chen po dran pa nam mkhas/ stang dmu tsha gyer med la gdams te/ byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la bka' gter du spros so/ u ya/ bkra shis 'gro ba'i don rnams lhun 'grub shog/
